title: platform-standup-2026-04-01
body:
Standup notes for 2026-04-01 - Platform Engineering

Attendees: Jordan, Priya, Omar, Lena, Samir, Alex

Summary:
- Focus this week on control-plane routing rollout, quota enforcement bugfix, and auth token expiry issue seen in staging.
- Small-scale canary of new routing policy planned for Friday EOD behind feature flag.

Updates:
1) Control Plane / Routing
- Priya: Completed compatibility tests for multi-tenant routing table changes. Found edge case when fallback routing triggers for pinned-model requests (PLAT-482). Working on patch that preserves pin metadata. Patch in review: github.com/.../pull/987. Expect merge by 2026-04-02.
- Omar: Implemented telemetry hooks to surface route decision traces to Console. Added sampling at 1% for now to avoid storage blowup. Need UX alignment for trace UI (meeting with Console team Thurs). Linked confluence page for design.
- Next: Canary rollout Friday to 5% traffic in us-west1. Runbook updated in Confluence; removal rollback via feature-flag toggle.

2) Auth
- Lena: Investigated higher-than-expected token refresh failures in staging. Root cause: race between refresh job and cache eviction when KMS latency spikes. Temporary mitigation: extend refresh window from 5s to 30s in staging. Long-term: add jitter and backoff to cache eviction logic. Ticket created: PLAT-489.
- Action: Lena to propose change and perf test plan by 2026-04-03.

3) Quotas & Billing Controls
- Samir: Quota enforcement bug causing incorrect burst allowance when quota reset crosses midnight UTC. Patch deployed to staging; observing results. If green, promote to canary Tues 2026-04-06.
- Also started work on per-customer rate-limiting metrics (token-level breakdown). Need to finalize schema for Console ingestion.

4) Incidents / Reliability
- No P0 incidents since last standup. Minor degraded throughput on 2026-03-30 traced to autoscaler misconfig for dedicated pools; fix merged.
- Reminder: run local chaos test next Wednesday to validate fallback policies between regions.

Blockers:
- Routing patch depends on small runtime change from serving-runtime team. Omar to coordinate with runtime leads; meeting scheduled today 11:30am.
- Quotas schema needs sign-off from Console ingestion team; Samir to sync with Alex (Console) after standup.

Action items:
- Priya: finish routing patch review and coordinate canary (due 2026-04-02).
- Omar: finalize trace sampling config and present to Console UX (due 2026-04-02).
- Lena: propose auth cache eviction fix + perf test (due 2026-04-03).
- Samir: validate quota patch in staging and schedule canary (target 2026-04-06).
- Jordan: update runbook for Friday canary and confirm on-call rotation.

Notes / links:
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PLAT/Canary+Runbook
- Jira: PLAT-482 (routing), PLAT-489 (auth), PLAT-498 (quotas)
- Slack thread: #platform-routing for routing discussion

Misc:
- Planning: start drafting Q2 roadmap item for unified observability (reduce time-to-debug for routing decisions). Will propose next week.

End of notes.
